name: organizing a technical review
from: A work product carried toward a funding decision on its author's confidence: reviewers unnamed, entry criteria unstated, the checkpoint about to rule on soundness it has no verdict about.
to: A review that happened: the work product named against its baseline, the reviewers named and none of them its author, the entry conditions checked before anyone's time was spent, and a verdict on the record — pass, pass-with-risk, or fail — that is advisory input to the checkpoint and binding on no one.
cost: The organizing itself — scope, reviewers, entry check, the record of the verdict — spent by an office that gains nothing either way the verdict lands.
otherwise: The decision checkpoint opens on nothing: the funding body either judges soundness itself, which collapses the separation, or funds unsound work, which the separation exists to prevent.
